root.name: Englund Gambit: Soller Gambit Deferred
root.moves: 1. d4 e5 2. dxe5 Nc6 3. Nf3 f6

overview: After 1.d4 e5 2.dxe5 Nc6 3.Nf3 Black plays 3...f6 instead of 3...Qe7, a deferred Soller idea trying to rebuild the pawn centre. White can take with exf6 or develop with Nc3, and keeps the extra pawn with a simple edge. Strong players consider it unsound for Black.

white_ideas.idea: Take on f6 or play Nc3 and keep the extra pawn
Develop with e3 and Bd3 or Bf4

black_ideas.idea: Recover the e5 pawn with ...Qe7 or ...fxe5

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with a White pawn on e5 and a Black pawn on f6

character.notes: A gambit that relies on traps and quick development.

gambit.notes: Black gives a central pawn and White can keep it.

soundness.reason: The Englund is a dubious gambit.

plans.reason: Black plays for development and traps.
